The '''1M-G Battle Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used during the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Ghost Squad]] used these droids during the [[Conquest of Makeb]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
1M-G Battle Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' during a Heroic mission on [[Makeb]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
